entities.summary: Ganna (Anna) Yuriyivna Yudkivska is a Ukrainian lawyer and judge. She was the judge of the European Court of Human Rights in respect of Ukraine in 2010–2022. She is a Member of the United Nations Working Group on Arbitrary Detention.
